title: Status transfer
description: Move a task between workflow stages with immediate spatial feedback.
useCase: Move a task between workflow stages with immediate spatial feedback.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: One isolated task and two stages. Native desktop drag plus a keyboard/touch move button; no workflow persistence.
look: Light blue-grey page with two pale rounded columns: a dashed empty slot in one, a white task card with initials avatar in the other.
motion: Dragging the card to the other column, or pressing its check or arrow button, slides it across with a 250 ms ease-out translate; it dims to half opacity while dragged.
adapt: The move is a `transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` transition on `.task`, toggled by `done` from native `onDrop` or the button; `translateX(calc(100% + 14px))` assumes two columns. Replace the task and columns with real data; keep the button for keyboard and touch.
